title: 第39章：杨家往事

第39章：杨家往事-《道士下山之749局》

上一章

存书签

下一章

胡九郎微微一怔，随后发出爽朗的笑声。

“我没事！我虽然不能给自己算一卦，但是师父在我下山的时候说了，我无论发生什么事，都不会死！”

杨童也是叹了口气。

“出事也不一定非得是付出生命！”

胡九郎说道：

“你不要多想……”

杨童摇了摇头。

“我不能不多想，只道我为什么不想跟你说杨家的事情吗？”

胡九郎淡然道：

“没关系，不想说就不说，即便是有什么，那也是杨家的事情，过往的事情，跟你又没有什么关系。”

杨童迟疑了一下。

“杨家以前确实是玄门世家，但并不是什么正经的玄门，反而做过很多错事。几十年前，我爷爷那一代，曾经和阴尘阁勾结，残害了不少无辜的玄门弟子，也抢夺了很多玄门法器。那时候五仙一直守护着东北一带的玄门秩序，看到杨家如此作恶，便出手阻止，杨家不服，便联合阴尘阁的人，偷袭了五仙的据点，杀害了不少五仙的侍从。”

胡九郎听到这里，也是倒吸一口凉气，没想到杨家居然还有这一层的隐事。

杨童继续说道：

“也就是从那时候起，杨家和五仙结下了不共戴天的怨仇，后来，阴尘阁背信弃义，反过来攻打杨家，杨家损失惨重，不少族人都死在了阴尘阁的手里，爷爷也在那场战乱中去世了。奶奶为了保护我，在我很小的时候，就带着我离开了杨家坳，去了外地，再也没有回来过。”

胡九郎忍不住问道：

“你们杨家和阴尘阁居然还有这些恩恩怨怨？”

“我从小就知道，杨家是个污点，是个充满罪恶的地方，所以我一直刻意隐瞒自己的身世，不愿意提及杨家的任何事情。我加入749局，一方面是为了弥补杨家当年的过错，但是和阴尘阁的恩怨，之前我也不知道，只是隐约听奶奶提到过，具体什么事我也不清楚，奶奶后来也过世了，这次我回老家，听堂哥说起才知道！”

胡九郎说道：

“这些事跟你是没有关系的啊！记住怀璧无罪，即降生天地之间就被天地所包容，如果有人或者仙家因为这个要杀你，我胡九郎第一个不答应！

杨童低声道：

“终究是爷爷做了错事，我心中还是有些自卑的，我也想要替爷爷他们恕罪……”

Hu Jiulang was slightly startled, and then burst into hearty laughter.

"I'm fine! Although I can't tell myself a fortune, Master told me when I came down the mountain that no matter what happens to me, I won't die!"

Yang Tong also sighed.

“It doesn’t have to cost your life if something goes wrong!”

Hu Jiulang said:

"Don't think too much..."

Yang Tong shook his head.

"I can't stop thinking about it and just ask why I don't want to tell you about the Yang family?"

Hu Jiulang said calmly:

"It doesn't matter. If you don't want to say it, don't say it. Even if there is something, it is the Yang family's business. Past events have nothing to do with you."

Yang Tong hesitated.

"The Yang family was indeed a Xuanmen family before, but it was not a serious Xuanmen family. Instead, it did many wrong things. Decades ago, my grandfather's generation colluded with Yinchen Pavilion and killed many innocent Xuanmen disciples, and also robbed manyXuanmen magic weapon.At that time, the Five Immortals had been guarding the Xuanmen order in the Northeast. When they saw the Yang family doing such evil, they took action to stop it. The Yang family refused to accept it, so they teamed up with people from the Yinchen Pavilion and attacked the Five Immortals' stronghold and killed many of the Five Immortals' attendants."

When Hu Jiulang heard this, he also took a breath. He didn't expect that the Yang family actually had such hidden things.

Yang Tong continued:

"From that time on, the Yang family and the Five Immortals formed a sworn feud. Later, the Yinchen Pavilion betrayed its trust and attacked the Yang family. The Yang family suffered heavy losses. Many members of the clan died at the hands of the Yinchen Pavilion. My grandfather also died in the war. In order to protect me, my grandma took me away from the Yang Family'ao when I was very young and never came back."

Hu Jiulang couldn't help but ask:

"You, the Yang family, and the Yinchen Pavilion actually still have these grievances and grievances?"

"I have known since I was a child that the Yang family is a stain and a place full of sin, so I have always deliberately concealed my life experience and was unwilling to mention anything about the Yang family. I joined the 749 Bureau partly to make up for the mistakes of the Yang family. However, I didn't know about the grudges with the Yinchen Pavilion before. I only vaguely heard my grandma mention it. I don't know what it was about. My grandma later passed away. This time I went back to my hometown and heard about it from my cousin!"

Hu Jiulang said:

"These things have nothing to do with you! Remember that Huaibi is innocent, that is, he is tolerated by heaven and earth when he is born. If someone or the immortal family wants to kill you because of this, I, Hu Jiulang, will be the first to refuse!

Yang Tong whispered:

"After all, it was grandpa who did something wrong. I still feel a little inferior in my heart. I also want to forgive grandpa and the others..."
